q1.uncertainty: Original focal-player cluster sandwich; full covariance for sums; t critical value with players minus one df.
q1.interpretation: Post-upset sums describe age/experience associations after upset losses; interactions describe their difference from ordinary-loss associations. Neither is causal.

settings.support_note: Explicit heuristics, not guarantees of accurate asymptotic inference.
settings.direction: Positive improvement favors the second model.
settings.dependence_note: Dyadic scores account for repeated pairs and pairs sharing either participant. Residual dependence between disjoint pairs, including tournament shocks, is not addressed.
settings.original_meeting_groups: Finer saved groups remain in outputs_final/q2_model_metrics.csv; no new model fits or subgroup search.

chronology.method: Join existing screened player/event IDs to original index/follow-up matches. Q2 history screens use strictly earlier tournament-start/round blocks and original last-ten eligible records.
chronology.count_units: Q1 flagged_unique_matches counts distinct index-match IDs, not every follow-up match; Q2 counts physical evaluation matches. Window totals and history exposures overlap.
chronology.limitation: Candidate event exposure is not a proven ordering error or proof that a fitted prediction changed. Histories include warm-up records. Cumulative exposure is broad; last-ten exposure is more specific to prior form. Actual match dates and unrecorded events remain unresolved.
